What we do not collect

There are no accounts. We do not collect your name, email address, contacts, precise location or advertising ID. Our server does not keep your photo or your reading. This version shows no ads.

Your photo and the AI

To write your reading, the app sends the photo you choose to our server, and our server sends it to an AI model provider. Before sending, the app resizes the photo, turns it upright and removes camera details such as GPS position and device name. The photo is sent only after you agree in the app, every connection is encrypted, and our server does not store the photo or write it to any log. We use provider settings that ask for zero data retention and no training on your photo. You can withdraw your agreement at any time by clearing the app's data.

Your reading history stays on your phone

The app saves each photo and reading in a history on this phone only so you can reopen it. It is never uploaded for storage. Settings, Delete my data erases the whole history at once; uninstalling the app removes it too.

Entertainment only

Readings are written by an AI for fun. They are not medical, health, financial, legal or life advice and they predict nothing. Please do not use them to make decisions.

Reporting a reading

If a reading seems wrong or inappropriate, use Report this reading on the result screen. It opens an email to us; the reading text is not attached unless you add it.

Subscriptions

Pro is a subscription sold through Google Play. RevenueCat helps us confirm and restore it. We never receive your payment details.

Service providers

The app uses these third-party services, which process data on our behalf under their own privacy terms:

  • RevenueCat — subscription and purchase status (privacy policy)

Purchases

Subscriptions are processed by Apple or Google. We receive confirmation of your purchase status (through RevenueCat) but never your payment details.

AI features

When you use AI features, the content you submit is sent to our server and to our AI provider to produce a response. We do not use your content to train AI models. Do not submit information you do not want processed this way. You can report problematic AI output from within the app.

Children

AI Palm Scanner is for adults aged 18 and over and is not directed to children. The app asks your age on first launch and does not work for people who say they are under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has used the app, email us and we will help.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or the CCPA) you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your data and to object to certain processing. Contact mercurysols197@gmail.com (or use the support page) and we will respond within 30 days.

Security and transfers

Data is transmitted over encrypted connections. Service providers may process data in countries other than yours.

Changes

If this policy changes materially we will update the date above and, where required, tell you in the app.
